answer.reason: Based on BLS QCEW data for Colorado in 2024 Q4, construction sector covered employment for December 2024 is approximately 186,127 jobs, not 291,799.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In the BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for Colorado, what was the December 2024 private-sector employment level, in covered jobs, for NAICS 23 Construction?

A. 291,799 covered jobs
B. 186,127 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, Colorado statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/08000.csv)

Supplied draft answer: A
